prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Atlanta for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on your needs. I can help find the right provider for you — but first: do you want someone near a particular Atlanta neighborhood or zip code? Do you have preferences (oral surgeon vs. periodontist vs. prosthodontist), a timeline (same‑day implant/all‑on‑4 vs. conventional), budget/insurance constraints, or medical issues (diabetes, smoking, etc.)?

While you decide, here are practical steps and a short checklist to pick a top implant dentist in Atlanta.

Who places implants
- Oral & maxillofacial surgeons: complex surgery, bone grafts, IV sedation.
- Periodontists: specialize in gums and implant placement.
- Prosthodontists: focus on the restorative (crowns, bridges) portion; often partner with surgeons.
- Experienced general dentists with advanced implant training can also be excellent.

What to look for (criteria)
- Relevant training and credentials (DDS/DMD + specialty training; look for fellowship/AAID credentials, ABO certification where applicable).
- Experience: number of implants placed and types of cases (single teeth vs. full‑arch).
- Use of modern diagnostics/tech: CBCT (3D imaging), digital treatment planning, guided surgery.
- Collaborative care: surgeon and restorative dentist coordinate care.
- Before/after photos and patient testimonials.
- Clear explanation of the treatment plan, timeline, risks, alternatives, and costs.
- Good follow‑up care and a clear warranty/guarantee policy.
- Board certification or membership in professional implant organizations (AAID, ICOI, American College of Prosthodontists, etc.).

Questions to ask at a consultation
- How many implants do you place per year? How many similar cases have you done?
- What implant system do you use and why?
- Do you perform the restoration (crown/bridge) yourself or refer to another dentist?
- Will you use CBCT imaging and guided surgery?
- What are my options for sedation/anesthesia?
- What is the expected timeline from surgery to final restoration?
- What are the risks and your complication/success rates?
- What will this cost (break out placement, grafting, abutment, crown) and what financing/insurance options exist?
- Can I see before/after photos and patient references?

How to find and verify providers
- Use AAID, American College of Prosthodontists, or ADA “Find a dentist” directories.
- Check patient reviews (Google, Yelp, Healthgrades) but weigh them alongside credentials and before/afters.
- Call offices and ask for details, then compare consultations.

If you give me your Atlanta neighborhood or ZIP code (and any preferences), I’ll compile a short list of high‑quality implant specialists and what to expect from each so you can book consultations.
